arxiv-1802-07946.title: SecDec: a toolbox for the numerical evaluation of multi-scale integrals
arxiv-1802-07946.description: Abstract We present a new version of SecDec , a program for the numerical computation of parametric integrals in the context of dimensional regularization. By its modular structure, the python rewrite py SecDec is much more customizable than earlier versions of SecDec . The numerical integration is accelerated using code optimization available in FORM .

arxiv-2009-10643.title: mage: Fluid Moves Between Code and Graphical Work in Computational Notebooks DOI: https://doi.org/10.1145/3313831.XXXXXXX Conference: UIST’20, October 20–23, 2020, Minneapolis, MN, USA
arxiv-2009-10643.creator: Mary Beth Kery Donghao Ren Fred Hohman Dominik Moritz Kanit Wongsuphasawat Kayur Patel
arxiv-2009-10643.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Mary Beth Kery Donghao Ren Fred Hohman Dominik Moritz Kanit Wongsuphasawat Kayur Patel. We aim to increase the flexibility at which a data worker can choose the right tool for the job, regardless of whether the tool is a code library or an interactive graphical user interface (GUI). To achieve this flexibility, we extend computational notebooks with a new API mage, which supports tools that can represent themselves as both code and GUI as needed.

arxiv-2208-10666.title: Sasaki-Einstein 7-manifolds and Orlik’s conjecture
arxiv-2208-10666.creator: Jaime Cuadros Valle, Joe Lope Vicente
arxiv-2208-10666.description: Abstract . We apply Orlik’s conjecture to study the homology groups of certain 2-connected 7-manifolds admitting quasi-regular Sasaki-Einstein metrics, among them, we found 52 new examples of Sasaki-Einstein rational homology 7-spheres, extending the list given by Boyer, Galicki and Nakamaye in [ 7 ] .

arxiv-2211-14404.title: Dynamical stability in a non-Hermitian kicked rotor model
arxiv-2211-14404.creator: Wen-Lei Zhao, Huiqian Zhang
arxiv-2211-14404.description: Abstract We investigate the quantum irreversibility and quantum diffusion in a non-Hermitian kicked rotor model for which the kicking strength is complex. Our results show that the exponential decay of Loschmidt echo gradually disappears with increasing the strength of the imaginary part of non-Hermitian driven potential, demonstrating the suppress of the exponential instability by non-Hermiticity.

arxiv-2510-11023.title: Parareal in time and spectral in space fast L1 quasilinear subdiffusion solver
arxiv-2510-11023.creator: Josefa Caballero, Łukasz Płociniczak, Kishin Sadarangani
arxiv-2510-11023.description: Abstract We consider the initial–boundary value problem for a quasilinear time‑fractional diffusion equation of order 0 < α ≤ 1 0<\alpha\leq 1 , and develop a fully discrete solver combining the parareal algorithm in time with a L1 finite‑difference approximation of the Caputo derivative and a spectral Galerkin discretization in space.

pmc-11305532.title: A cytidine deaminase regulates axon regeneration by modulating the functions of the Caenorhabditis elegans HGF/plasminogen family protein SVH-1
pmc-11305532.creator: Tatsuhiro Shimizu, Takafumi Nomachi, Kunihiro Matsumoto, Naoki Hisamoto, Anne C. Hart, Gregory P. Copenhaver, Anne C. Hart, Gregory P. Copenhaver, Anne C. Hart, Gregory P. Copenhaver, Anne C. Hart, Gregory P. Copenhaver
pmc-11305532.description: The pathway for axon regeneration in Caenorhabditis elegans is activated by SVH-1, a growth factor belonging to the HGF/plasminogen family. SVH-1 is a dual-function factor that acts as an HGF-like growth factor to promote axon regeneration and as a protease to regulate early development.

pmc-11343840.title: CGJO: a novel complex-valued encoding golden jackal optimization
pmc-11343840.creator: Jinzhong Zhang, Gang Zhang, Min Kong, Tan Zhang, Duansong Wang
pmc-11343840.description: Golden jackal optimization (GJO) is inspired by mundane characteristics and collaborative hunting behaviour, which mimics foraging, trespassing and encompassing, and capturing prey to refresh a jackal’s position. However, the GJO has several limitations, such as a slow convergence rate, low computational accuracy, premature convergence, poor solution efficiency, and weak exploration and exploitation.

pmc-12498370.title: Safety, tolerability and immunogenicity of a quadrivalent recombinant norovirus vaccine (Pichia pastoris) in participants six weeks of age or older: Phase I/IIa trial
pmc-12498370.creator: Gang Chen, Liwei Shi, Qingchuan Yu, Qingwei Liu, Xuanyi Wang, Yan Liu, Fan Ding, Lingfeng Yuan, Ping Wang, Xiang Zhou, Yong Zhang, Zhong Huang, Jingjing Li, Zhongyu Hu, Teng Huang
pmc-12498370.description: Noroviruses are the leading cause of epidemic acute gastroenteritis and foodborne diarrheal disease in humans. Here, a randomized, double-blind, multi-cohort, placebo-controlled clinical trial was performed to determine the candidate vaccine’s safety and immunogenicity. The experimental framework incorporated an initial Phase I age/dose-escalation stage followed by a Phase IIa dose-expansion component.

pmc-12690703.title: SPCT-04 KISSING CERVICAL SPINE SCHWANNOMAS IN A YOUNG FEMALE FROM A LIMITTED SETTING: A CASE REPORT
pmc-12690703.creator: Franck Sikakulya, Joseph Mary Ssembatya, Blessing Taremwa, David Kitya
pmc-12690703.description: Background and AimsMultiple schwannomas are typically associated with neurofibromatosis type 1 (NF1), but rare cases occur independently of neurofibromatosis. Schwannomas are benign, slow-growing tumors, primarily affecting the cervical and lumbar spine. When large, they may extend over multiple vertebral levels, posing surgical challenges.

pmc-12749706.title: Reactive air plasma treatment enhances extraction yield and bioactive anti-aging properties of wheat lipids
pmc-12749706.creator: Hyun-Joo Kim, Narae Han, Jin Hee Bae, Kyeong-Hoon Kim, Moon Seok Kang, Cheorun Jo, Sanghoo Park
pmc-12749706.description: Few studies have investigated reactive air plasma (ReAP) treatment to enhance wheat lipid extraction and evaluate its potential anti-aging properties. Here, the effects of ReAP treatment on wheat lipids were assessed with a focus on improving lipid yield and bioactivity.

pmc-13242028.title: Assessing the hepatic and renal parameters of breast cancer patient blood samples before and after chemotherapy
pmc-13242028.creator: Ghaith B Heilat, Tahani Alwidyan, Amjad Z Alrosan, Aseel O Rataan, Khaled Alrosan, Rehaf B Ahmad, Kinda R Al-Kammash
pmc-13242028.description: Breast cancer (BC) is the most common malignancy in women, with chemotherapy as a fundamental treatment despite its potential to cause hepatotoxicity and nephrotoxicity. Although routine assessment of organ function is customary, the predictive value of composite liver-kidney biomarkers for post-chemotherapy survival remains inadequately investigated.

pmc-13440231.title: Implementation evaluation of nurse-initiated care in 29 Australian emergency departments: a RE-AIM multi-method evaluation
pmc-13440231.creator: Sarah Kourouche, Julie Considine, Ling Li, Margaret Murphy, Saartje Berendsen Russell, Louise Casey, Rebecca Richardson, Ramon Z. Shaban, Christina Aggar, Michael M. Dinh, Amith Shetty, Timothy Shaw, Radhika V. Seimon, Nanda R. Aryal, Kate Curtis
pmc-13440231.description: BackgroundNurse-initiated care improves timely treatment access, but adoption varies. The Ministry of Health introduced 73 Emergency Care Assessment and Treatment (ECAT) protocols for public emergency departments (EDs) to standardise nurse-initiated care. A behaviour change strategy was used to implement ECAT in 29 EDs as part of a trial, using implementation strategies like education, clinical champions, videos, and audit and feedback.
